packages/.purpose: run the @jankurai/ux-qa rendered UX QA test suite

schemas/.purpose: verify the UX QA report and policy JSON Schemas stay valid against the suite

tools/.purpose: verify the deterministic smoke-server fixture harness used by the suite

package.json.purpose: verify the workspace manifest resolves against the locked dependency graph

package-lock.json.purpose: verify the locked dependency graph installs and stays consistent

Justfile.purpose: verify the root command surface lanes are runnable

VERSION.purpose: verify the declared package version stays coherent with release metadata

CHANGELOG.md.purpose: verify the changelog tracks released versions

README.md.purpose: verify the root readme routes to the workspace layout

LICENSE.purpose: verify the license file is present and unmodified

AGENTS.md.purpose: verify split-family agent routing remains present

.jeryu/.purpose: verify local Jeryu and GitHub mirror metadata

agent/.purpose: verify split control maps and standard metadata

scripts/.purpose: verify local CI and fusion helpers

.gitignore.purpose: verify the exclusion list keeps transient build paths untracked

contracts/.purpose: verify the generated UX QA report contract and client stay consistent with the source schemas

.gitleaksignore.purpose: scan secrets with exact historical documentation fingerprints
